question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Imbalance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word '**imbalance**' means lack of proportion or uneven distribution. (अनुपात का अभाव या असमान वितरण)

 
 
• **Example**: *The sudden increase in demand created an imbalance in the supply chain.*
